description: Hand-curated ownership history for the licences behind the Danish fields with production data, read from the ENS amendment lists in data/sources/licences/raw/. Each licence has a timeline of periods; each period gives the shares (percent) per legal entity, how certain they are (basis), and verbatim quotes from the sources (evidence) that scripts/ingest_ownership_history.py checks against the raw files. Entities carry their legal name and group over time, so renames and acquisitions do not need their own periods.

basis.stated: The source states these shares (or states the transfer that produces them from the previous stated period).
basis.derived: Computed from shares and transfers the source states, e.g. today's shares minus a stated transfer; the period's note says how.
basis.unknown: The source names the owners but not their shares.
